(a) Let $z = x + \mathrm{i}y$ be any non-zero complex number.
(i) Express $\frac{1}{z}$ in the form $u + \mathrm{i}v$.
(ii) If $z + \frac{1}{z} = k$, $k \in \mathbb{R}$, show that either $y = 0$ or $x^2 + y^2 = 1$.

(b) Let $w = \cos\theta + \mathrm{i}\sin\theta$.
(i) Show that $w^n + w^{-n} = 2\cos n\theta$, $n \in \mathbb{Z}$.
